channel.title: Get Paid On Time
channel.description: Plain-language guides on net-30 terms, reminder sequences, and late fees. Written for freelancers and one-person businesses who send invoices and wait.

item.title: Invoice reminder schedule for freelancers
item.description: Five invoice reminders: 3 days before due, then 1, 7, 14, and 30 days late. Send one at a time. Stop when paid. (이 글은 인공지능으로 작성되었습니다.)

item.title: Late fee versus interest on a late invoice
item.description: A late fee is a flat amount. Interest is a rate over time. Both must be in the agreement before the invoice is late. (이 글은 인공지능으로 작성되었습니다.)

item.title: What net 30 means on an invoice
item.description: Net 30 means payment is due 30 calendar days after the invoice date. It is a contract term, not a law. Print the due date. (이 글은 인공지능으로 작성되었습니다.)
